rock-skill-rock-throw.name: Rock Throw
rock-skill-rock-throw.description: New skill: hurls a rock at a foe 2-3 hexes away (Power 45).

rock-skill-rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
rock-skill-rock-tomb.description: New skill: boulders hit a foe up to 3 hexes away and Slow it for 2 turns.

rock-skill-stone-edge.name: Stone Edge
rock-skill-stone-edge.description: New skill: a brutal stone strike on a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

rock-bedrock.name: Bedrock
rock-bedrock.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage and deals 20% more damage to adjacent foes.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 6 damage; +1 Defense.

rock-solid-rock.name: Solid Rock
rock-solid-rock.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP; +2 Defense.

rock-landslide.name: Landslide
rock-landslide.description: +25% damage while 2+ foes stand next to it; +1 Attack, +1 Defense.

rock-skill-head-smash.name: Head Smash
rock-skill-head-smash.description: New skill: a crushing headbutt on an adjacent foe (Power 110).
